research_completion_policy: Reference readiness needs sourced values or explicit bounds, a native comparison and specified acceptance observations. WCL-dependent values (DPS references, cast timelines, melee calibration, 10N health) stay blocked until the report pages can be read.
acceptance_observations: Native clear of Atramedes in the atramedes_c0 shard after the route kills 8 spirits and rings the bell (bell_ready, bell, intro_wait nodes complete natively).
Every Searing Flame channel ends by a Resonating Clash within 2 s of its start (Vertigo on Atramedes).
No player reaches 100 Sound (no Noisy! aura, no Devastation event).
Tracking Flames target never shares the beam with another player for more than one tick.

Shields used per kill <= 4 at 10N and never below the Searing Flame reserve before a Searing Flame; each use records clicker, reason (searing_flame, sound_emergency, sound_high, air_breath_rescue) and phase; withheld gongs record their *_at_reserve reason.
Air phase: melee and tank do not path under the flying boss; Sonar Bomb hits per player <= 1 per air phase.
0 boss-window deaths; encounter_fidelity reports DamageModifier status for 41442.
Sonic Breath kiter: no bearing reversal around the boss during a breath; no 78100 tick on the kiter after the first channel second.
